name: Parkway Plaza
summary: Mall with department stores, restaurants, movie theater & family amenities like a 2-level carousel.
demographics: Westfield Parkway Plaza primarily serves families and middle-income households in East County San Diego, including El Cajon, Santee, and La Mesa. The trade area consists of a diverse demographic mix with significant Hispanic and working-class populations, with median household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $75,000. Typical visitors include value-conscious shoppers seeking mainstream retailers, families taking advantage of entertainment options like the movie theater, and local residents looking for convenient one-stop shopping for everyday needs.
description: Westfield Parkway Plaza is a premier shopping destination in El Cajon offering the latest movie showings, diverse dining options, and a pet-friendly environment where visitors can bark-and-browse their favorite stores. The center features year-round events including Photos with Santa, hot deals from beloved brands, and special promotions delivered directly to insider subscribers.
